Over the years I've eaten a lot of candy, including a lot of extreme candies like the toe of Satan that's supposed to be super hot, or warheads that are supposed to be super sour. The only problem though, is that in my opinion they aren't very extreme because they only assault one sense at a time. What I want to make is a candy, that targets everything (sour, sweet, spicy, icy, bitter, salty and umami, and short circuits my brain.
